name: Vikraman
greetingText: To a professor who makes every round an opportunity to learn...
wishText: May the year ahead bring you happiness, good health, and success — and may your questions during rounds continue to inspire us to keep learning! 😄
text1: Today, the questions can wait... it's your special day! 😄
textInChatBox: Happy Birthday, Sir! Thank you for your constant guidance, for helping me improve my PPTs, and of course, for always making me think a little deeper during rounds!
text2: I thought I'd simply wish you Happy Birthday...
text3: But then I realised... a simple birthday wish wouldn't be enough.
text4: Because your guidance has helped me
text5Content: Your questions may challenge us, but they always encourage us to learn a little more.
outroText: I hope you liked this little surprise, Sir!
replayText: And once again, wishing you a very Happy Birthday! 😊
